summary: Feed s151_double to NDR is degraded: 5.6% TCP packet drops and 94.0% GRE-encapsulated traffic. NDR requires both directions and full payload but cannot reassemble incomplete streams or inspect inner packets while tunneled.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN aggregation is dropping packets under load: 159 of 2860 TCP packets (5.56% vs 1% threshold) show gaps/retransmissions indicating missing data before the NDR.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR TCP reassembly fails, flows appear incomplete, detections missed and false negatives increase; 5.6% loss breaks stateful analysis that needs both directions and full payload.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across NDR cluster / reduce per-tool rate and broker egress oversubscription to eliminate drops; also verify TAP vs SPAN and broker buffer/capture capacity.

findings.root_cause: Traffic is forwarded still encapsulated in GRE (2780 of 2958 frames, 94.0% vs 10% threshold) - packet broker is not stripping tunnels before delivery.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR sees only outer GRE headers, cannot parse inner IP/TCP and application payload for 94% of traffic, effectively blind to lateral movement, C2 and exfiltration inside tunnels.

recommended_fix.why: Terminate/strip GRE at packet broker and forward inner packets to NDR so it can apply full-payload inspection and detection on de-encapsulated traffic.
